list.title: Building a Structured Express.js Application with MongoDB: A Comprehensive Guide
list.subheading: Mastering Web Development: A Deep Dive into Structuring an Express.js Application with MongoDB
list.excerpt: Explore how to effectively structure an Express.js application integrated with MongoDB. This comprehensive, no-nonsense guide covers configuration, controllers, middleware, models, routes, error handling, and scalability best practices for real-world Express.js and MongoDB applications.
list.author: Paul Serban

list.title: Harness the Power of Express.js and MongoDB with Docker Compose: A Local Development Guide
list.subheading: Streamline Your Express.js and MongoDB Development Environment Using Docker Compose
list.excerpt: Discover how to streamline your web development process by setting up a local development environment using Express.js, MongoDB, and Docker Compose. Our comprehensive guide offers step-by-step instructions, complete with code snippets, to help you master this crucial aspect of modern backend development.
list.author: Paul Serban

list.title: Python's SimpleHTTPServer: A Quick Guide to Local Web Hosting

list.author: Paul Serban

list.title: CORS in Production: Deployment Patterns for Multi-Environment REST APIs

list.author: Paul Serban

list.author: Paul Serban

list.author: Paul Serban

list.title: Jobee - Job Search App
list.subheading: RESTful API and Platform for Job Seekers and Employers
list.excerpt: Comprehensive job search platform, implemented as a RESTful API. It's built using Node.js, Express.js, and MongoDB, with a focus on performance, reliability, and scalability. The API supports a wide array of features, including advanced search filters, authentication, and file uploads, among others.
